name: diag.report
title: diag.report
summary: Push diagnostics from another process (player, import worker) onto this host's bus.
html:
Push diagnostics from another process (player, import worker) onto this host's bus.

  • Scope: read
  • Service: diag

#Params

ParamRequiredDescription
sessionyesSession handle from session.begin; its author is the diagnostics' origin unless the reporter is the engine (engine: true).
diagnosticsyesDiagnostics as JSON ({code, severity, message, location?, subjects?, fixes?, data?}), each optionally with causedBy: the index of an earlier diagnostic in this batch that caused it.
tickSimulation tick they happened on.
engineThe reporter is an engine process (player, import worker), not the session's author.
